scenes.alt: कमलों भरी झील में कान पर कमल टिकाती लड़की और किनारे पर दो दोस्त
scenes.prompt: A forest lake crowded with lotuses; Padmavati stands in the water with her attendants, fully dressed, setting a lotus at her ear and meeting the prince's eyes; the prince and his friend sit on the shaded bank.

scenes.alt: उदास राजकुमार को कमल के इशारों का अर्थ समझाता दोस्त
scenes.prompt: In a palace room at evening, an untouched food plate; the smiling friend holds up a lotus and explains on his fingers to the lovesick prince.

scenes.alt: हाथीदाँत के कारीगर का घर: नीचे कार्यशाला, ऊपर खिड़कियाँ
scenes.prompt: An ivory carver's house in section: craftsmen with fine chisels below, a master lifting a comb to the light, white dust in the air; large windows and a garden above.

scenes.alt: साँझ को खिड़की से रस्सियों वाले पीढ़े पर उतरती बूढ़ी
scenes.prompt: At dusk, maids lower an old woman on a small rope seat from a high window to the garden beside a wall and a tree; Padmavati directs from the window.

scenes.alt: दीये की रोशनी में खिड़की के पास राजकुमार का स्वागत करती पद्मावती
scenes.prompt: A lamp-lit upper room at night; Padmavati rises to welcome the prince who has just come through the window; tender and modest.

scenes.alt: आँगन में पकवान का थाल, उसे देर तक देखता दोस्त और पास एक कुत्ता
scenes.prompt: A small courtyard: a tray of sweets and betel; the friend holds one piece toward a stray dog while the prince watches uneasily.

scenes.alt: रात में बंद खिड़की, लटकता पीढ़ा और आग पर तपता लोहे का त्रिशूल
scenes.prompt: Night: a small iron trident glowing in a brazier in the foreground, the prince's hand on it; behind a drawn curtain only a still sleeping shape; the empty rope seat at the window. No wound or body shown.

scenes.alt: श्मशान में तपस्वी के भेस में बैठा दोस्त, हार थामे राजकुमार
scenes.prompt: In a cremation ground at dawn the friend sits disguised as an ascetic with a rosary by a fire; the prince as disciple receives a jewelled necklace.

scenes.alt: शोक में बैठा राजा, हाथ में पहचाना हुआ हार
scenes.prompt: A grieving king on his throne gazes long at a necklace in his hand while the city officer reports; heavy still court.

scenes.alt: साँझ को नगर के फाटक से बाहर निकाली जाती पद्मावती, पीछे रोते माँ-बाप
scenes.prompt: At the city gate at dusk, guards lead Padmavati out toward the forest; far behind, her parents weep at their doorway.
